source_used: robots.txt -> sitemap_index-global.xml -> products-us.xml (761 URLs) -> /on/demandware.store/Sites-US-Site/en_US/Product-Variation?pid=<id> (public JSON); PDP JSON-LD sampled on 2 pages for validation
problems: mpn/sku = SFCC product id; JSON-LD on sampled PDPs states mpn==sku==productID, no separate manufacturer part number exposed
condition not stated in Product-Variation JSON nor PDP JSON-LD (no itemCondition) -> null
seller_name set to "Weber" only because product is sold online on weber.com (online=true); first-party store

category_path = store category slugs from the canonical URL path (e.g. "gas > smart-gas-grills"); display names need the PDP breadcrumb (1 extra request/product, over budget). pageTitle was unusable (no category in 97/120)
brand: Product-Variation brand null for 18/120 -> filled "Weber" (single-brand first-party store, per brief)
sale_price: only 1/120 has a list (strike-through) price above sales price; rest sell at one price
variants: only the variant URLs listed in products-us.xml were taken; sibling variants (other colors) not expanded
2 Product-Variation calls timed out (curl 000) on first pass, succeeded on retry
variantMsg field says "out of stock or unavailable" even for in-stock items - ignored; availability from availability.messages + preOrder
parts--et--support (278 URLs) excluded by design; selection = gas25/charcoal20/griddle15/pellet8/electric6/portable4/accessories42, evenly spaced in sitemap order
weight only where spec "Weight (pounds)" exists; size only where a "size" variation attribute exists
